videos.script: A customer in Pinheiros places an order at 19:04, from a phone in a lift with no signal. The event reaches Quitanda four minutes later. {{lift}} Every event has two times. When it happened, and when the pipeline saw it. Lesson 21 counted by the second one, which puts this order in the wrong window. {{clocks}} Windows cut the stream by the first time instead. Fixed windows, sliding windows, and sessions that close when a customer goes quiet. {{windows}} But a window has to end somewhere. The watermark is the pipeline's guess that nothing older is still coming. When it passes the end of a window, the window fires. {{watermark}} The guess is sometimes wrong. An order that arrives behind the watermark is late, and by default it is thrown away, without a word. {{late}} You will replay one evening with Beam's TestStream, so the arrival order and the watermark are yours to set and every run gives the same answer. {{replay}} Then you will keep late orders for five minutes, fire early results, and choose whether each result replaces the last or adds to it. {{panes}}
